trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Aegean Bliss Resort, Disney World, Orlando, Florida

day_by_day.morning: No morning activities — flight arrives at 13:00. Rest and travel time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 13:00. Take the budget-friendly Sunshine Flyer or Mears Connect shared shuttle to Aegean Bliss Resort (~$16-25/person vs $35+ for private). Check in, unpack, and get oriented. Pick up a Disney World park map and review your week's park tickets. Walk around the resort grounds and explore the beachfront area to relax after travel.
day_by_day.evening: Head to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket needed) via complimentary Disney bus from the resort. Explore the outdoor shopping and entertainment district, enjoy live street performances, browse World of Disney store, and soak in the Disney atmosphere as a soft introduction to the trip.

meals.breakfast: Eat before or at the airport — grab a quick bite at MCO Airport food court to save money.
meals.lunch: Pick up snacks or a quick meal at a resort convenience store or grab a fast-casual meal near the resort to keep costs low (~$8-12).
meals.dinner: Disney Springs: Chicken Guy! by Guy Fieri (~$12-15) or grab a hot dog and churro from a Disney Springs cart (~$8-10) for a budget-friendly first Disney meal.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase a 5-day Magic Your Way base ticket in advance online for best savings (~$109-119/day). Download the My Disney Experience app before arrival. Wear comfortable walking shoes from day one. Bring a refillable water bottle — Disney allows outside food and drinks.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early (6:30 AM) and head to Magic Kingdom — the most iconic Disney park. Arrive at rope drop (park open ~9:00 AM) to beat crowds. Use Lightning Lane (free tier) via the app. Prioritize: Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, Tomorrowland Speedway, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Haunted Mansion before crowds build. Grab a Mickey-shaped pretzel (~$6) as a mid-morning snack.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom. Visit Fantasyland (Peter Pan's Flight, It's a Small World), Liberty Square, and Adventureland (Pirates of the Caribbean, Jungle Cruise). Use the free Lightning Lane return times to minimize wait. Take a midday break at a shaded bench or cool off in an air-conditioned shop during peak heat (1-3 PM).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom evening spectaculars — HarmoniUS Fireworks and Disney Enchantment light show (free with park admission, typically ~9:00 PM). Grab a spot 30 minutes early near the hub for a great view. Exit after the fireworks via the monorail back to the resort area.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the resort before heading out — grab cereal, fruit, or pastries from the resort's grab-and-go market (~$5-8) to save vs. in-park breakfast.
meals.lunch: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Magic Kingdom — one of the best budget options in the park. Counter service burgers, chicken, and salads (~$12-16).
meals.dinner: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — clam chowder, fish and chips, or chicken sandwich (~$13-17). Excellent value and less crowded than other dining spots.

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom is the most popular park — arriving at rope drop is essential on a budget trip to maximize ride time without paying for Lightning Lane+ upgrades. Bring snacks from the resort in a small backpack to avoid expensive in-park snacking. Stay hydrated — free water is available at any quick-service location.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT for rope drop (~9:00 AM). Start in World Discovery — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue via app — join at park open!) and Test Track. Then move to World Nature for Soarin' Around the World (use Lightning Lane return if wait exceeds 45 min). Explore the beautiful EPCOT gardens and the newly renovated park entrance.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring EPCOT's World Showcase — 11 country pavilions around the lagoon. This is completely free to walk and explore once inside. Visit Mexico (free boat ride inside the pyramid), Norway (Frozen Ever After ride), China, Japan, and France pavilions. Sample affordable international snacks: Norwegian school bread (~$5), Mexican churro (~$5), Japanese mochi (~$4).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT Forever or Luminous: The Symphony of Us nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (~9:00 PM). Watch from the World Showcase promenade for a free and stunning end to the day. Take the Disney Skyliner gondola back to the resort area (free Disney transportation).

meals.breakfast: Pack a light breakfast from the resort (granola bars, fruit, water bottle) to eat on the bus ride to EPCOT.
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — one of the best value quick-service spots at Disney. Fresh salads, sandwiches, rotisserie chicken (~$12-15).
meals.dinner: World Showcase food stands — budget-friendly international bites. Try: a crepe from France kiosk (~$7), chips and guac from Mexico (~$6), and a Dole Whip (~$6) for a fun, affordable 'tasting' dinner around the world (~$20 total).

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase opens at 11:00 AM, so plan World Discovery rides first thing. The Guardians virtual queue fills up INSTANTLY at park open — have the app ready and join the moment it's available. EPCOT is the most walkable park and great for budget dining via food kiosks.

day_by_day.morning: Take a rest morning — sleep in until 8:00 AM. Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort. This is a recovery day to avoid burnout on a 7-day trip. Visit the resort's beachfront area for a relaxing morning swim. This also saves money by not spending a full park day and lets you recharge for the remaining days.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Disney's BoardWalk area (free, no park ticket needed) via Disney bus. Walk the 1/4-mile waterfront promenade along Crescent Lake. Visit ESPN Club, browse boutique shops, watch street performers, and enjoy the nostalgic Atlantic City-inspired atmosphere. Then visit the nearby Yacht & Beach Club resort lobby and Beach Club beach area for free lakeside relaxation.
day_by_day.evening: Take the Disney Skyliner to Hollywood Studios for the evening (3:00 PM - park close). This is a great strategy — evening crowds are lighter. Ride Slinky Dog Dash (join Lightning Lane early), Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance, and Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Stay for the nighttime spectacular — Fantasmic! (check showtimes, typically 8:00 or 9:30 PM — free with admission).

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — pick up items from the resort market (yogurt, fruit, bagels ~$6-9) for a relaxed, affordable morning meal.
meals.lunch: Pack a picnic-style lunch from resort convenience store — sandwiches, chips, and drinks (~$10-12 total) to enjoy at the BoardWalk waterfront.
meals.dinner: Hollywood Studios: Backlot Express — counter service burgers, hot dogs, and chicken strips in a fun movie prop setting (~$12-15). Budget-friendly and quick.

day_by_day.notes: A mid-trip rest morning is highly recommended for budget travelers with families — it prevents exhaustion and keeps morale high for the second half of the trip. Hollywood Studios evening entry means you still get 5-6 hours of park time. Fantasmic! is one of Disney's best shows and completely free with park admission.

day_by_day.morning: Full day at Hollywood Studios — arrive at rope drop (9:00 AM). Morning priority: Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run immediately (if you didn't the night before), then explore Batuu — browse the Docking Bay 7 area, visit Savi's Workshop (splurge optional ~$250 for lightsaber, skip if budget-conscious), and take photos at the Millennium Falcon. Then head to Toy Story Land for Toy Story Mania and Alien Swirling Saucers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: Tower of Terror, Rock 'n' Roller Coaster, Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular (free show, great for resting feet), Muppet*Vision 3D, and the Animation Courtyard. Check the Times Guide for show schedules and build your afternoon around free entertainment shows to maximize value.
day_by_day.evening: Catch the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular fireworks show if available (check Disney calendar). Then head back to the resort by 9:30 PM for rest. Tomorrow is Animal Kingdom day.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the resort before departure — keep it simple with cereal or toast from your room stash of groceries.
meals.lunch: Backlot Express or Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — Ronto Wraps (~$13) are a fan favorite and worth the price for the Star Wars experience.
meals.dinner: Hollywood Studios: ABC Commissary — counter service with burgers, wraps, and plant-based options (~$12-15). One of the most affordable table-style counter service spots in the park.

day_by_day.notes: Friday tends to be busier at Hollywood Studios — use Lightning Lane free tier aggressively via the app. Galaxy's Edge is best explored in the morning before it gets crowded. Bring your own bottled water and snacks to avoid expensive in-park purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom — arrive at rope drop (8:00 AM, often the earliest opening park). First priority: Avatar Flight of Passage in Pandora — The World of Avatar. Join the virtual queue or Lightning Lane the moment the park opens — waits can exceed 2 hours otherwise. Then ride Na'vi River Journey and explore the bioluminescent Pandora landscape. Head to Africa next: Kilimanjaro Safaris (best in morning when animals are most active).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Asia: Expedition Everest (one of Disney's best roller coasters), Kali River Rapids (get wet — great on a hot June day!), and Maharajah Jungle Trek (free walking trail with tigers and birds). Visit DinoLand U.S.A. for DINOSAUR ride. Catch the Festival of the Lion King stage show — an incredible free entertainment value (~30 min show, check Times Guide).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Rivers of Light nighttime show or Tree of Life Awakenings (projections on the Tree of Life — free, runs every 10-15 min after dark). Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (~8:00-9:00 PM). Return to resort and have a relaxed evening — pack for checkout tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Arrive early — grab a quick Joffrey's coffee and a muffin from a park cart (~$7) upon entry.
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — one of the best value and best-tasting quick service meals at Disney World. Ribs, pulled pork, chicken (~$14-17). Eat at the outdoor waterfront seating overlooking the river.
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Local Food Cafes in Asia — counter service Asian-inspired dishes: egg rolls, teriyaki beef bowls (~$12-15). Skip the full-service Yak & Yeti Restaurant to save money.

day_by_day.notes: Saturday is typically the busiest park day — arrive at Animal Kingdom EARLY (before 8:00 AM if possible). Animal Kingdom is the most nature-focused park and a great change of pace from the thrill-heavy previous days. The Kilimanjaro Safari is best in the morning — animals are more visible and active in cooler temperatures.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort and take a last swim at the beachfront. Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort (checkout typically 11:00 AM). Store luggage with the bell desk if your flight is later in the day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend a final few hours at Disney Springs (free, no park ticket needed) — great for last-minute souvenir shopping on a budget. Best budget souvenirs: Disney Trading Pins (~$10-15), pressed pennies (50 cents!), Disney Springs branded items (often cheaper than in-park). Visit the LEGO store (free to browse), AMC Disney Springs, and grab a final Disney treat. Head to the airport via Mears Connect shared shuttle — book in advance for best rates (~$16-25/person).
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando. Reflect on an incredible budget Disney World week!

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — use up any remaining groceries or snacks purchased during the trip to minimize waste and cost.
meals.lunch: Disney Springs: Earl of Sandwich — one of the best value meals on Disney property. Hot sandwiches, salads (~$8-11). A perfect final Disney meal.
meals.dinner: Airport meal at MCO or on the flight — budget ~$12-15 for airport food court options.

day_by_day.notes: Budget tip: The best budget souvenirs at Disney are pressed pennies (machines throughout all parks, 51 cents each), Disney Trading Pins, and items from the Disney Springs Marketplace Co-Op. Avoid buying souvenirs inside the parks where prices are highest. Total estimated budget for 7 days (excluding flights and hotel): Park tickets ~$550-600 (5-day base ticket), meals ~$35-50/day per person, transportation ~$50-70 round trip. Total trip savings tips: Bring snacks and a refillable water bottle daily, eat one meal outside parks when possible, use free Disney transportation exclusively, and book all tickets and dining in advance online.

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight arrives at 13:00. Travel from Orlando International Airport to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World (~30–45 min by Magical Express or rideshare). Check in, unpack, and get settled into your Beachfront room.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort grounds after check-in. Take a leisurely walk along the beachfront area, locate the pool, familiarize yourself with resort amenities, and pick up any supplies from the resort shop. Rest and recharge after the flight.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening – Head to Disney Springs (complimentary Disney bus from resort) for your first taste of Disney magic. Browse unique shops like World of Disney, catch live street entertainment, and soak in the atmosphere along the waterfront.

meals.breakfast: On the flight or grab a snack at Orlando International Airport before baggage claim.
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bite at the resort's casual poolside café or food court upon arrival to settle in comfortably.
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs – Mid-range waterfront dining featuring fresh seafood, steaks, and burgers. Try the fish tacos or lobster roll. Budget approx. $25–$45 per person.

day_by_day.notes: No park tickets needed today. Focus on recovery from travel. Purchase or confirm park tickets and download the My Disney Experience app tonight if not already done. Make any dining reservations for the week through the app.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day (Part 1) – Arrive at rope drop (~9:00 AM) via Disney resort bus. Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin before crowds build. Then move to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and Peter Pan's Flight using Lightning Lane if available.
day_by_day.afternoon: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day (Part 2) – After a midday break, explore Adventureland (Pirates of the Caribbean, Jungle Cruise) and Liberty Square (Haunted Mansion). Use this time to grab a Lightning Lane for the most popular remaining rides. Take a midday break at the resort if energy dips (resort buses run frequently).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom nighttime spectacular – the iconic 'Disney Enchantment' fireworks show over Cinderella Castle (typically 9:00 PM). Stake out a spot on Main Street U.S.A. at least 30 minutes early for the best view.

meals.breakfast: Resort hotel buffet or quick-service breakfast at the resort food court before heading out.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square – Mid-range quick service with clam chowder, fish & chips, and sandwiches. Budget approx. $12–$18 per person.
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant (Fantasyland) – Mid-range table service inside Beast's Castle. Book in advance via My Disney Experience. Enjoy French-inspired cuisine like braised pork or roasted chicken. Budget approx. $30–$50 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Genie+ and individual Lightning Lane selections early in the morning for Space Mountain and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen – June in Orlando is hot and humid (expect 88–95°F). Stay hydrated throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour (Part 1) – Take the resort bus to EPCOT. Start with Future World/World Discovery in the morning – ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track early before lines grow. Then transition to the World Showcase as it opens at 11:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour (Part 2) – Stroll clockwise through the 11 international pavilions: Mexico (boat ride inside the pyramid), Norway (Frozen Ever After ride), China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Sample international snacks and beverages at each pavilion. Don't miss the stunning topiaries and cultural entertainment.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Harmonious' nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check current schedule for 2027). Grab a dessert party package or simply find a lakeside spot for the show.

meals.breakfast: Quick continental breakfast at the resort before departure.
meals.lunch: Teppan Edo (Japan Pavilion) – Mid-range teppanyaki-style dining with hibachi chicken, shrimp, and vegetables cooked tableside. Book in advance. Budget approx. $25–$40 per person.
meals.dinner: La Crêperie de Paris (France Pavilion) – Mid-range French café featuring savory buckwheat crêpes and sweet dessert crêpes with cider. Budget approx. $20–$35 per person. Alternatively graze on international snacks from pavilion food stands for a more casual dinner.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the most walkable park – wear very comfortable shoes. The World Showcase is a food lover's paradise; budget extra for snack sampling between pavilions (factor in $20–$30 for food stall treats). Check the EPCOT app for live cultural performances and entertainment schedules at each pavilion.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure (Part 1) – Take an early resort bus to Hollywood Studios. Head directly to Galaxy's Edge at Batuu the moment the park opens. Ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run first (shorter early morning wait), then join the virtual queue or Lightning Lane for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance – one of Disney's most immersive attractions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Hollywood Studios (Part 2) – Visit Savi's Workshop to build your own custom lightsaber (approx. $249.99 – optional splurge). Alternatively, browse Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities for Star Wars collectibles. Then explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: Tower of Terror, Rock 'n' Roller Coaster, and Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash, Alien Swirling Saucers).
day_by_day.evening: Catch the 'Fantasmic!' nighttime show at Hollywood Studios (check current 2027 schedule). This spectacular water and fire show is a Hollywood Studios highlight. Arrive 45–60 minutes early to secure good seats in the amphitheater.

meals.breakfast: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo (Galaxy's Edge) – Quick-service Star Wars–themed breakfast with items like Ronto Morning Wraps (roasted pork, egg, and pepper hash in a warm pita). Budget approx. $12–$16.
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box (Toy Story Land) – Quick-service fan favorite with grilled cheese sandwiches, BBQ brisket melts, and totchos (tater tot nachos). Budget approx. $12–$18 per person.
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant – Mid-range table service in a drive-in movie theater setting showing classic sci-fi clips. Enjoy burgers, pasta, and milkshakes. Budget approx. $25–$40 per person. Book in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Lightsaber building at Savi's Workshop requires a reservation made through My Disney Experience – book as early as possible as slots fill up weeks in advance. If skipping the lightsaber experience, use that afternoon time for a second ride on Rise of the Resistance or explore Sunset Boulevard more thoroughly.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience (Part 1) – Take the resort bus to Animal Kingdom for rope drop. Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Flight of Passage (the park's most popular ride with the longest waits – use Lightning Lane). Then ride Na'vi River Journey for a more relaxed Avatar experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience (Part 2) – Join the Kilimanjaro Safaris (best in the afternoon when animals are active). Spot elephants, lions, giraffes, hippos, and more on this 18-minute open-air safari. Follow with the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and DINOSAUR attraction in DinoLand U.S.A. Catch the 'Festival of the Lion King' stage show (check schedule).
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a relaxed evening. Enjoy the resort's beachfront area, take a swim in the pool, and wind down. This is a great recovery evening before the final park days.

meals.breakfast: Satu'li Canteen (Pandora) – Quick-service with hearty breakfast bowls featuring plant-based proteins and grain bases. Budget approx. $12–$16 per person.
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue – Mid-range quick service with ribs, pulled pork, and smoked chicken in a beautiful waterfront outdoor setting. Budget approx. $14–$20 per person.
meals.dinner: Resort hotel restaurant or poolside bar & grill for a casual, relaxed meal. Many Disney resorts offer mid-range dining options on-site. Budget approx. $20–$35 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (typically 7:00–8:00 PM) so plan your day accordingly. Flight of Passage is extremely popular – securing a Lightning Lane reservation at 7:00 AM is strongly recommended. Bring insect repellent for the outdoor safari and nature trails.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Return Visit (Morning) – Head back to Magic Kingdom to experience any rides or attractions missed on Day 2, or re-ride favorites. Focus on Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, Splash Mountain (check 2027 status), and the updated Tron Lightcycle / Run attraction in Tomorrowland. Enjoy the Main Street Bakery for a mid-morning treat.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort Relaxation & Pool Time – Return to Aegean Bliss Resort by early afternoon. Spend quality time at the beachfront and pool – a perfect mid-trip recharge. Many Disney resort pools feature waterslides, splash zones, and poolside activities. This balance of park time and resort relaxation is key to avoiding burnout.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Evening (Return Visit) – Head back to Disney Springs for any shopping you may have skipped on Day 1. Visit the Lego Store, Pandora jewelry, and Disney-branded outlets. Enjoy live entertainment from street performers and musicians along the waterfront promenade.

meals.breakfast: Main Street Bakery (Magic Kingdom, Starbucks-affiliated) – Grab a coffee, pastry, or breakfast sandwich before hitting the rides. Budget approx. $8–$14.
meals.lunch: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn & Café (Magic Kingdom, Frontierland) – Quick-service Tex-Mex with nachos, burgers, and rice bowls. Budget approx. $12–$18 per person.
meals.dinner: STK Orlando (Disney Springs) – Upscale mid-range modern steakhouse with a lively atmosphere. Splurge slightly on this final evening out with filet mignon, truffle fries, and creative cocktails. Budget approx. $45–$70 per person. Alternatively, Rainforest Café at $25–$40 per person for a more family-friendly option.

day_by_day.notes: Saturday is typically one of the busiest days at Disney parks. If crowd levels are high at Magic Kingdom, consider arriving at rope drop and leaving by noon to beat the peak afternoon crowds before heading back to the resort pool. Check the My Disney Experience app for real-time wait times.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT Return or Final Park Choice – Spend a final relaxed morning at EPCOT to revisit favorite pavilions, ride Remy's Ratatouille Adventure (France Pavilion), or explore any areas missed on Day 3. Alternatively, use this morning for last-minute souvenir shopping at Disney Springs or the resort gift shop.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort Check-Out & Leisure – Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort (standard check-out is typically 11:00 AM; request late check-out if available). Store luggage with the bell service and spend a final afternoon enjoying the resort grounds or a nearby Disney area. Reflect on the week's highlights and begin travel preparations.
day_by_day.evening: Departure Preparation – Collect luggage from bell service and arrange transportation to Orlando International Airport. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before departure for travel time and airport security. Pick up any last Disney souvenirs at the airport Disney Store in the terminal.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast buffet as a final celebratory meal – many Disney resorts offer character dining options for a magical send-off. Budget approx. $20–$35 per person (character dining) or $12–$18 quick service.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at EPCOT's World Showcase food stands or a casual café near the resort before check-out. Budget approx. $12–$18 per person.
meals.dinner: Airport dining at MCO or an in-flight meal depending on departure time. Budget approx. $15–$25 at the airport.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your return flight details and transportation to the airport the night before. Disney's Magical Express (or its 2027 equivalent) may offer complimentary airport transfers – check with the resort concierge. Leave extra time for any final souvenir purchases. Pack any liquids or park merchandise carefully in checked luggage.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Disney World, Orlando, Florida Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

hotel.name: Aegean Bliss Resort, Disney World, Orlando, Florida

experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day
experiences.description: Experience the iconic Magic Kingdom with classic rides like Space Mountain, Pirates of the Caribbean, and the Haunted Mansion. Watch the spectacular Festival of Fantasy parade and end the night with the breathtaking Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle.
experiences.best_time_of_day: Morning (arrive at rope drop 8:00 AM to maximize ride time before crowds peak)
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in the Star Wars universe at Batuu. Build your own lightsaber at Savi's Workshop, pilot the Millennium Falcon on Smugglers Run, and experience the thrilling Rise of the Resistance ride. Enjoy themed food and drinks at the Oga's Cantina bar.
experiences.best_time_of_day: Evening (atmosphere and lighting are most immersive after dark)
experiences.location: Disney's Hollywood Studios, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
experiences.description: Stroll through 11 international pavilions representing countries like Japan, Morocco, France, and Mexico. Sample authentic cuisine and snacks from each country, watch live cultural performances, and explore unique architecture and art. A perfect blend of food, education, and entertainment for the whole family.
experiences.best_time_of_day: Afternoon to Evening (pavilions are liveliest with performances from 12 PM onward)
experiences.location: EPCOT World Showcase, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience
experiences.description: Embark on the Kilimanjaro Safaris to see real African wildlife including elephants, lions, and giraffes in a naturalistic savanna setting. Then journey to Pandora – The World of Avatar for the stunning Flight of Passage ride and the Na'vi River Journey, especially magical when bioluminescent effects glow at night.
experiences.best_time_of_day: Morning for safari (animals are most active), Evening for Pandora (bioluminescence glows after dusk)
experiences.location: Disney's Animal Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening
experiences.description: Spend a relaxed evening at Disney Springs exploring over 60 dining options, unique shops, and live entertainment. Enjoy dinner at The BOATHOUSE or T-REX Cafe for a family-friendly themed experience, watch street performers, and browse the World of Disney store. No park ticket required, making it a budget-friendly family night out.
experiences.best_time_of_day: Evening (most vibrant atmosphere with live music and entertainment from 6 PM)
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight LH arrives at 13:00. Relax during your flight and prepare for arrival.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 13:00. Take a pre-arranged private luxury transfer (Rolls-Royce or Mercedes-Benz Sprinter) to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in to your Beachfront suite, enjoy a welcome amenity, and take a leisurely stroll along the resort's beachfront to decompress from travel. Explore the resort's pools, spa facilities, and grounds.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a relaxed first evening at Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment. Browse the vibrant waterfront district, enjoy live entertainment, and soak in the atmosphere of over 60 unique shops and venues. A perfect low-key introduction to the Disney World experience.

meals.breakfast: In-flight premium dining or airport lounge breakfast at Orlando International Airport (The Club MCO Lounge)
meals.lunch: Light welcome refreshments and fruit platter arranged by the resort upon check-in
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia at Disney Springs — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship pan-Asian restaurant offering exquisite sushi, dim sum, and whole fish dishes in a stunning two-story setting. Reserve the private dining room for an exclusive experience.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange your private airport transfer before departure. Request early check-in with the resort if possible. Unpack, hydrate well, and keep the evening light to recover from travel. Purchase Disney MagicBand+ wristbands at the resort or pre-link them to your Disney account for seamless park access all week.

day_by_day.morning: Begin your Disney adventure with a full day at Magic Kingdom Park. Arrive at rope drop (park opening, typically 8:00–9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Use Lightning Lane Premier Pass to access top-tier attractions first: ride Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, Space Mountain, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Explore Fantasyland and take iconic photos at Cinderella Castle.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue your Magic Kingdom Full Day experience through the afternoon. Experience Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, and Tomorrowland attractions. Enjoy a mid-afternoon parade such as the Festival of Fantasy Parade. Cool off with a Dole Whip at Aloha Isle. Take a private VIP Tour Guide (Disney's official VIP Tour Service) to skip lines and gain behind-the-scenes insights.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the spectacular ENCHANTMENT nighttime spectacular — a dazzling fireworks and projection show over Cinderella Castle. Afterward, enjoy a relaxing private transfer back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Cinderella's Royal Table inside Cinderella Castle — a once-in-a-lifetime character dining experience with a prix-fixe breakfast and meet-and-greets with Disney Princesses. Book 60 days in advance.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House or Be Our Guest Restaurant (Beast's enchanted castle) — enjoy a leisurely French-inspired lunch in one of Magic Kingdom's most immersive dining settings.
meals.dinner: California Grill atop Disney's Contemporary Resort — a AAA Four Diamond restaurant with panoramic views of Magic Kingdom's fireworks, featuring farm-to-table cuisine, premium sushi, and an award-winning wine list.

day_by_day.notes: Book the Disney VIP Tour Service well in advance (407-560-4033) — it costs approximately $425–$750 per hour with a 7-hour minimum but is worth every penny for a luxury, crowd-free experience. Wear comfortable premium sneakers. Bring a portable fan or cooling towel for the Florida June heat.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Hollywood Studios for the Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure. Arrive early to secure a boarding group or Lightning Lane for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance — one of the most technologically advanced rides ever built. Explore the planet of Batuu, interact with droids and stormtroopers, and immerse yourself in the living Star Wars story.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Savi's Workshop for a private, ceremonial lightsaber-building experience (approximately $299 per lightsaber — reserve in advance). Afterward, pilot the Millennium Falcon on Smugglers Run. Explore the Droid Depot to build a custom droid companion. Visit Oga's Cantina for exotic themed cocktails and mocktails in an atmospheric alien bar setting.
day_by_day.evening: Catch the Fantasmic! nighttime spectacular at Hollywood Studios — a water, fire, and projection show starring Mickey Mouse. Afterward, enjoy a premium private transfer back to the Aegean Bliss Resort for a nightcap at the resort bar.

meals.breakfast: In-resort breakfast at the Aegean Bliss Resort's signature beachfront restaurant — enjoy a lavish buffet or à la carte eggs Benedict, smoked salmon, and fresh tropical fruits while overlooking the water.
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo inside Galaxy's Edge — enjoy themed dishes like Smoked Kaadu Ribs and Fried Endorian Tip-Yip (chicken) for an authentic Batuu dining experience.
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — an upscale waterfront dining experience featuring prime steaks, fresh seafood towers, Maine lobster, and vintage Dream Boats. Request a waterside table for the best ambiance.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop requires advance reservations and fills up extremely quickly. Book exactly 60 days before your trip at 7:00 AM EST. The lightsaber experience is approximately 20 minutes and deeply immersive — well worth the premium price for Star Wars fans. Oga's Cantina is also reservation-required.

day_by_day.morning: Spend a rejuvenating morning at the Aegean Bliss Resort's luxury spa. Book a 90-minute couples or individual massage, facial, or hydrotherapy treatment. Enjoy the resort's private beach, infinity pool, and cabana service. This mid-trip rest day is essential for recharging before the second half of your Disney adventure.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to EPCOT for the World Showcase Food & Culture Tour. Begin at World Showcase Lagoon and stroll through international pavilions representing Japan, Morocco, France, Canada, Italy, and Mexico. Sample premium food and beverages at each pavilion — from French crêpes and Japanese Kirin beer to Mexican margaritas and Norwegian school bread. Enjoy the stunning architecture and cultural entertainment.
day_by_day.evening: Stay at EPCOT for the EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon — one of the largest nighttime shows ever created for a Disney park, featuring fireworks, lasers, and illuminated kites. Afterward, enjoy a private luxury transfer back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely in-room breakfast ordered via butler service at the Aegean Bliss Resort — fresh-squeezed juices, pastries, eggs cooked to order, and a mimosa or Bloody Mary.
meals.lunch: Monsieur Paul at EPCOT's France Pavilion — an AAA Four Diamond French fine-dining restaurant inspired by legendary chef Paul Bocuse, offering classic French cuisine with an elegant atmosphere and exceptional wine pairings.
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo at EPCOT's Japan Pavilion — a premium teppanyaki experience where skilled chefs prepare Wagyu beef, lobster, and seasonal vegetables tableside with theatrical flair in a beautifully appointed Japanese setting.

day_by_day.notes: The spa morning is intentionally unscheduled to allow flexibility — you may choose to sleep in, enjoy the resort pool, or explore resort amenities. EPCOT's World Showcase opens at 11:00 AM, so an afternoon arrival is perfectly timed. Monsieur Paul requires advance dining reservations.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on the Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience. Arrive early for the Kilimanjaro Safaris — a 20-minute open-vehicle safari through 110 acres of African savanna where you'll encounter free-roaming elephants, giraffes, lions, hippos, and rhinos. Morning is the best time for active wildlife sightings. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for up-close primate encounters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Journey to Pandora — The World of AVATAR for an awe-inspiring afternoon. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage — a breathtaking banshee-riding simulation over the floating mountains of Pandora (one of Disney's most popular attractions — use Lightning Lane). Experience Na'vi River Journey, a serene boat ride through bioluminescent rainforest. Explore the stunning Pandoran landscape, which glows magnificently as dusk approaches.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the Aegean Bliss Resort for a premium private dinner experience. Arrange a private beachfront candlelit dinner through the resort's concierge — a bespoke menu crafted by the resort's executive chef, served under the stars with ocean breezes and curated wine pairings.

meals.breakfast: Tusker House Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — a character dining buffet featuring Donald Duck and friends in safari attire, with African-inspired dishes including bobotie, pap, and carved meats alongside classic American breakfast items.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — try the Cheeseburger Steamed Pods, Slow-Roasted Grains Bowl, or Blueberry Cream Cheese Mousse for a themed and surprisingly delicious mid-day meal.
meals.dinner: Private beachfront candlelit dinner at the Aegean Bliss Resort — coordinate with the resort concierge at least 48 hours in advance for a bespoke multi-course tasting menu with sommelier-selected wine pairings.

day_by_day.notes: Book Tusker House 60 days in advance. For Avatar Flight of Passage, use Lightning Lane first thing in the morning as virtual queues or Lightning Lane selections go extremely fast. The private resort dinner is a highlight of the trip — request rose petals, champagne, and a personalized menu to make it truly memorable.

day_by_day.morning: Return to Magic Kingdom for experiences you may have missed on Day 2, or revisit favorites with a fresh perspective. Explore Liberty Square and the Hall of Presidents. Enjoy a leisurely Jungle Cruise with its famously corny jokes. Visit Prince Charming Regal Carrousel and 'it's a small world' for classic Disney nostalgia. Browse Main Street, U.S.A. for premium Disney merchandise and collectibles.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Disney's BoardWalk area for a relaxed afternoon. Stroll the lakeside promenade, enjoy street performers, and browse artisan shops. Book a private IllumiNations-style boat rental or a guided pontoon boat tour of Bay Lake and Seven Seas Lagoon for a unique waterborne perspective of the Disney resort area.
day_by_day.evening: Conclude your Disney parks experience with a return to EPCOT's Future World for the Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind roller coaster (Lightning Lane required) and Test Track. Enjoy the evening atmosphere and a final farewell stroll through World Showcase.

meals.breakfast: The Plaza Restaurant on Main Street, U.S.A. at Magic Kingdom — a charming Victorian-era restaurant serving classic American breakfast with beautiful views of Cinderella Castle.
meals.lunch: Skipper Canteen at Magic Kingdom's Adventureland — a whimsical, story-rich restaurant with globally inspired cuisine including Jungle Navigation Co. Beef Tenderloin and Sustainable Fish of the Day.
meals.dinner: Space 220 Restaurant at EPCOT — a visually spectacular fine-dining experience that simulates dining 220 miles above Earth in a space station, with panoramic views of Earth from orbit projected on surrounding windows. Features contemporary American cuisine with astronomical theming.

day_by_day.notes: Space 220 is one of EPCOT's most sought-after reservations — book exactly 60 days out at 6:00 AM EST. The pontoon boat tour should be reserved through Disney's recreation team. Saturday is typically the busiest park day — use Lightning Lane Premier Pass liberally and arrive early.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a final luxurious morning at the Aegean Bliss Resort. Sleep in, enjoy a champagne breakfast on your beachfront balcony, take one last swim in the resort pool, or book a final spa treatment. Pack and prepare for departure at a relaxed, unhurried pace. Request a late checkout from the resort (typically available until 2:00 PM for premium guests).
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend your final afternoon at Disney Springs for last-minute luxury shopping and entertainment. Visit the World of Disney flagship store for premium collectibles and gifts. Browse Coca-Cola Store, UNIQLO, Pandora, and artisan boutiques. Enjoy a final leisurely lakeside stroll and capture memories of your magical trip.
day_by_day.evening: Private luxury transfer to Orlando International Airport for your departure flight. Reflect on an extraordinary week at Disney World filled with world-class experiences, premium dining, and unforgettable memories.

meals.breakfast: Champagne breakfast on the beachfront balcony of your Aegean Bliss Resort suite — arranged by butler service with fresh tropical fruits, pastries, smoked salmon, and a bottle of premium Champagne.
meals.lunch: STK Orlando at Disney Springs — a modern, high-energy steakhouse with premium USDA prime cuts, fresh seafood, and an extensive cocktail program. Perfect for a celebratory final lunch.
meals.dinner: Airport dining at MCO or in-flight — request a premium airport lounge (The Club MCO) for a comfortable pre-flight meal, or enjoy your airline's business/first-class in-flight dining service.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm late checkout with the resort at least 24 hours in advance. Allow at least 3 hours before your flight departure for the transfer to MCO, security, and boarding — Orlando International can be very busy on Sunday evenings. Consider shipping any large Disney purchases directly home through the resort's concierge to avoid baggage complications. Keep your MagicBand+ as a premium souvenir of your trip.
